about: Roberval is a city on the western shore of Lac Saint-Jean in Quebec, in the Maria-Chapdelaine country of Saguenay–Lac-Saint-Jean. A lake port, pilgrimage and literary associations, and the Traversée internationale swimming crossing define the waterfront city. Mashteuiatsh, the neighbouring Ilnu community, is a separate jurisdiction. About 10,000 people live in Roberval.
